column1: # Plainphone reviewed browser catalog (web-containment spec, design D4). Owner: lane C (:links).
# Columns (tab-separated): package, kind, status, source, notes.
#   kind:   BROWSER | ASSISTANT | APP_STORE are hidden and cannot be approved.
#           REVIEW is not hidden: the app can browse inside its own WebView or URL bar without a web intent filter.
#   status: EMULATOR or DEVICE = measured in the cited spike file; UNVERIFIED = package identity only, not run yet.
# Disclosure: navigation inside an approved app's own WebView is not intercepted (web-containment spec). REVIEW notes
# record what is known per app; the probe heuristic finds browsers that are not listed here.
# Play Store (com.android.vending) and Play services (com.google.android.gms) are never-hide and must not be listed.
